title: HB1725 (2017-2018 Regular): Establishing an exemption from background check requirements for firearms sales or transfers between concealed pistol license holders.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2017-18/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1725.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced. The only strike is the word 'or' at the end of (4)(f)/(g) as relettered; the rest of the section is existing law reprinted unchanged (subsection (1) requires background checks on all sales/transfers).

operative_text: Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (4) This section does not apply to: (h) The sale or transfer of a firearm where the seller or transferor and the purchaser or transferee both possess a valid concealed pistol license.
